name: bacitracin zinc + lidocaine + neomycin + polymyxin b
uses: Uses First aid to help prevent infection and temporary relief of pain in minor: cuts scrapes burns
otcwarn: Do not use do not use in the eyes do not apply over large areas of the body if you are allergic to any of the ingredients longer than one week unless directed by your doctor in large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas Ask a doctor Ask a doctor before use if you have serious burns deep or puncture wounds animal bites Stop use and ask a doctor Stop use and ask a doctor if if you need to use longer than 1 week condition persists or gets worse symptoms persist for more than 1 week, or clear up and occur again within a few days. rash or other allergic reaction develops
